pages.title: Augments
pages.text: Some equipment remembers more than ordinary use. Repeating an unusual, fitting action with one particular item trains an $(thing)augment$(). Its progress is separate from Bond levels and belongs to that item alone.

pages.title: Something Special
pages.text: An augment awakens when its training is complete. Each one changes behavior rather than merely adding another level bonus. Inspect the item's tooltip to see what it has begun learning.
